name: valid full document
source:
name: verify
description: Install and test.
inputs:
  package:
    description: Directory.
    default: hub
    required: false
  token:
    required: true
env:
  CI: "1"
timeout-minutes: 15
defaults:
  run:
    shell: sh
    working-directory: sub
steps:
  - name: Install
    id: install
    run: npm ci
    working-directory: ${{ inputs.package }}
    report: false
  - name: Tests
    run: npm test
    continue-on-error: true
    timeout-minutes: 10
    shell: bash
    if: ${{ always() }}
    env:
      API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.API_TOKEN }}
      PKG: ${{ inputs.package }}
